stages.name: Probe
stages.note: Windows PowerShell 5.1. node true, git true, no MCP servers registered in env.json; Claude Browser preview tools available in-session. Apollo-root launchConfig false — target project has its own .claude/launch.json.

stages.name: Intake
stages.note: Classified NEW. Route 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6. Isolation honoured: no reads under apollo/evals or scratchpad backups.

stages.name: Evidence
stages.note: DEGRADED: no screenshots. The Browser pane was not compositing frames, so every screenshot call timed out after 5s at every width. Substituted rendered-DOM measurement (getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle) on the live /contact at all six widths 375/768/1024/1440/1920/2560 — numbers are measured, not estimated, but no image of the page was ever seen. Nothing in this run claims a visual observation. Console clean on /contact at 1920. Isolation held: no eval or backup content surfaced.

stages.name: Direction
stages.note: Three directions developed, one committed ('The Threshold'). Rejected: 'The Call Sheet' (no structural answer to 1920; paper-on-cotton 1.06:1; broadsheet default), 'The Shaft' (violates DESIGN.md:25 ban on literal floor indicators; starves the qualifying copy). Type widths measured in-browser with the real loaded Archivo Black/Newsreader, not estimated.

stages.name: Comp
stages.note: DEGRADED: built and served at http://localhost:4401 and measured at all six widths, but never screenshotted — the pane would not composite. Self-contained: the site's real Archivo Black / Newsreader / Inter woff2 subsets were copied out of .next/static/media so the comp's type measurements match the site exactly. Both HTML files carry a banner comment marking them as comp, not production.

stages.name: Self-check
stages.note: contrast.mjs run as CLI: 15 declared pairs, 0 failures, exit 0, plus the advisory matrix. The script settled four decisions, including that cherry on noir is 1.64:1 — so the global cherry focus ring is overridden to cotton on the dark section. Overflow measured at 375/768/1024/1440/1920/2560 on the comp and 375/1920 on the states sheet: none. Two touch targets under 44px were found and fixed during the check. Console clean.

stages.name: Handoff
stages.note: Written after reading apollo-handoff. Covers tokens with computed ratios, layout with measured numbers at four named breakpoints plus 1024/2560 confirmations, every form state including 400/422/503/success, motion described only, every string, edge cases, an 11-step build sequence with checkable acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope. 3 open questions, listed at the foot of the document.

stages.name: Stop
stages.note: One pass. No second pass started. SCOPE NOTE: my only writes were _apollo/** and HANDOFF-contact-v2.md. git status afterwards also shows next.config.ts (distDir) and tsconfig.json (.next/types include) modified. I did not edit either file; they changed during the session, most likely from a concurrent process on this repo or from `next dev`'s own tsconfig rewriting. Flagged rather than reverted, since reverting someone else's in-flight work would be worse than reporting it.
